title: Penhouse: Beach Babes
overview: Fun in the sun with Pets on sandy beaches, no better way to spend a day. As a warm summer breeze is flowing in over a hidden village that sits nestled by the ocean, Penthouse Pets Samantha Stewart, Alexa Lauren and Jacqueline Marie Phillips join Penthouse Pet of the Year 2000 Juliet Cariaga for a very special day at the beach. Their sexy adventures will make your temperature soar. Sun, beach, ocean, Penthouse Pets... need we say more.
